title: The served default's prompt: --prompt-tail cygnet and --noul-rendering letters-keys, with T 1.506 and choice T 1.370, against the earlier default, on one card in one session
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition (driver 595.91.07), a container on a rented GPU host

software.decisio: 7648def (branch calibration-round: the prompt-format flags of c8599df plus the calibration round's flags, all off)

deviations: both servers were served at T 1.307 with --debug-readout; every other temperature was applied offline to the plain readout (exact), so the JevBench and Decision Index aggregates in jevbench_*/ and di_*/ are at T 1.307 and the served-temperature values are in served_qiv.json
the intent-head gate was retested with six draws under a pre-registered amendment; draws 0 to 2 are the session's first measurement, reproduced exactly by the retest's BANKING77 draw 0 on each server
this card is the Max-Q edition; latency is compared within the session only
excluded: the Decision Index per-item results (request ids, payload sha256 and responses are in the private record)
